answer: Proof of Stake functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism in AI agent economies. By requiring validators to lock capital, the protocol ensures that creating a virtual raven of identities incurs a real financial cost. Each new agent must purchase tokens to participate, preventing attackers from dominating the knoll of governance without massive expenditure. This threshold creates a velvet barrier of entry, forcing adversaries to weigh the high capital risk against the low probability of protocol subversion.
